title: Tracing Hallucinations in LLM Reasoning for UML Class Diagram Generation: An Empirical Taxonomy and Mitigation Study
title_zh: 追踪LLM在UML类图生成推理中的幻觉：实证分类与缓解研究

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate Unified Modeling Language (UML) class diagrams from natural-language requirements, but hallucinations may compromise the correctness and completeness of the resulting diagrams. Existing evaluations mostly assess the final diagram, without examining the intermediate traces of reasoning-capable LLMs, which can reveal where these hallucinations arise. We develop an empirical taxonomy of eleven hallucination sub-types organised into three dimensions: Prompt Faithfulness (deviations between requirements and reasoning), Code Faithfulness (discrepancies between reasoning and generated PlantUML code), and Reasoning Quality (problems within the reasoning itself). The taxonomy was derived from 60 manually annotated DeepSeek-R1 traces, applied to 120 further DeepSeek-R1 traces through a dual-LLM annotation pipeline, and examined on 20 DeepSeek-V4-Pro traces. Code Faithfulness was the most frequent dimension for DeepSeek-R1 in both datasets, whereas Prompt Faithfulness dominated for DeepSeek-V4-Pro, suggesting model-dependent failure patterns. In the manually annotated traces, reasoning-trace length showed no significant monotonic association with hallucination frequency, whereas requirement complexity was negatively associated with it, particularly for Prompt Faithfulness errors. In a mitigation experiment on 13 Golden UML ModelSet cases with three Qwen3-based models, adding Prompt Faithfulness and Reasoning Quality constraints to the generation prompt raised the pooled mean F 1 F_{1} score by 4.0 percentage points, whereas a post-hoc Code Faithfulness review provided no consistent further benefit. Relationship modelling remained the lowest-scoring element throughout. These results suggest that localising hallucinations within the generation process can inform targeted, prompt-based mitigation. Whether these findings generalise beyond the DeepSeek and Qwen3 model families remains to be tested.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）能够从自然语言需求生成统一建模语言（UML）类图，但幻觉可能会损害所得图表的正确性和完整性。 现有的评估大多只考察最终图表，而没有检视具备推理能力的 LLM 的中间推理轨迹，而这些轨迹可以揭示幻觉产生的原因。 我们建立了一个经验性的幻觉分类体系，包含十一个幻觉子类型，分为三个维度：提示忠实度（需求与推理之间的偏差）、代码忠实度（推理与生成的 PlantUML 代码之间的差异），以及推理质量（推理自身存在的问题）。 该分类体系源自 60 条人工标注的 DeepSeek-R1 轨迹，通过一个双 LLM 标注流程应用于另外 120 条 DeepSeek-R1 轨迹，并在 20 条 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 轨迹上进行了检验。 在两个数据集中，代码忠实度都是 DeepSeek-R1 最高频的维度，而提示忠实度则是 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的主要维度，这表明失败模式依赖于具体模型。 在人工标注的轨迹中，推理轨迹长度与幻觉频率之间没有显著的单调关联，而需求复杂度与幻觉频率呈负相关，尤其是对于提示忠实度类错误。 在一项针对 13 个 Golden UML ModelSet 案例并使用三个基于 Qwen3 的模型的缓解实验中，在生成提示中加入提示忠实度和推理质量约束使合并后的平均 F 1 F_{1} 分数提高了 4.0 个百分点，而事后进行的代码忠实度审查则未带来一致的进一步收益。 关系建模始终是得分最低的部分。 这些结果表明，在生成过程中定位幻觉有助于制定有针对性的、基于提示的缓解措施。 这些发现是否能够推广到 DeepSeek 和 Qwen3 模型家族之外，仍有待验证。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have rapidly become capable tools for automating a wide range of software engineering activities, including requirements analysis, code generation, and software design Li et al. (2022) ; Ataei et al. (2025) ; Fan et al. (2023) ; Hou et al. (2024) . A particularly promising application is the generation of Unified Modeling Language (UML) class diagrams from natural-language requirements Bari et al. (2024) ; Cámara et al. (2023) . Such generation addresses a fundamental challenge in software engineering: translating informal, often incomplete textual requirements into explicit structural representations that can guide subsequent design and implementation. Reliable automation at this stage could accelerate early design activities, strengthen requirements traceability, and support both professional modeling and software engineering education.

paragraphs.en: The usefulness of such automation, however, depends not only on whether an LLM can produce a syntactically valid diagram, but on whether the diagram faithfully represents the requirements. Existing studies show that LLM-generated UML models can contain hallucinated classes, attributes, operations, or relationships that are unsupported by, inconsistent with, or absent from the requirements Ji et al. (2023) ; Huang et al. (2025) . Recent empirical evaluations show that while LLM outputs are often syntactically valid and understandable, they suffer from significant issues related to completeness and correctness, particularly when requirements are ambiguous or complex Bari et al. (2024) ; Ferrari et al. (2024) ; Cámara et al. (2023) . This is particularly problematic for software models because structural errors can be deceptively plausible: a fabricated class, an unsupported association, or an incorrect multiplicity may pass superficial inspection while nevertheless influencing downstream design decisions, code generation, consistency checking, and design review. Understanding and preventing these errors is therefore essential if LLM-based modeling is to move from demonstration to dependable software engineering practice.

paragraphs.en: Hallucination in UML generation also differs fundamentally from hallucination in conventional text generation. Research has extensively studied hallucinations in tasks such as summarisation Maynez et al. (2020) , machine translation Raunak et al. (2021) , and code synthesis Zhang et al. (2025b) . In these settings, hallucination is commonly framed as a mismatch between generated content and a reference source or specification. UML generation introduces an additional challenge: the output is a structured artefact whose correctness depends on multiple transformations between the input requirements, the model’s internal reasoning, and the representation used to encode the diagram. Errors may therefore arise not only in the final artefact but at each of these transformations, and may propagate from one to the next.

paragraphs.en: This process-level view is particularly relevant for reasoning-capable LLMs. Rather than mapping requirements directly to a diagram, these models often generate explicit reasoning traces in which they identify candidate entities, infer attributes and operations, establish relationships, determine multiplicities, and finally translate these decisions into diagram code. This process creates several distinct failure points: an error introduced when interpreting the requirements can propagate through subsequent reasoning; individually plausible reasoning steps can collectively produce an unsound model; and a sound reasoning process can be corrupted during translation into PlantUML. Yet existing evaluations of LLM-generated UML diagrams largely focus on the quality of the final artefact, providing limited insight into where in the reasoning-to-diagram process hallucinations arise, how they propagate, and which failure modes are most prevalent. This lack of process-level understanding limits our ability to design targeted mitigation strategies. For example, although prompt engineering Freeman et al. (2026) ; Zhang et al. (2025a) , retrieval-augmented generation Lewis et al. (2020) ; Shuster et al. (2021) , and post-hoc verification Dhuliawala et al. (2024) ; Manakul et al. (2023) may address different failure mechanisms, their effectiveness depends on knowing which mechanisms actually drive UML generation errors. A systematic characterisation of these failure modes is therefore a necessary first step toward both understanding and improving the reliability of LLM-generated UML models.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we address this gap by constructing and validating an empirical taxonomy of hallucinations in reasoning-capable LLMs generating UML class diagrams, and by demonstrating how the taxonomy can be translated into actionable mitigation strategies. The taxonomy identifies three dimensions corresponding to the generation process: Prompt Faithfulness , capturing deviations between the requirements and the model’s reasoning; Reasoning Quality , capturing unsoundness within the reasoning chain; and Code Faithfulness , capturing discrepancies between the reasoning and the resulting PlantUML representation. Across these dimensions, we identify eleven hallucination sub-types. paragraphs.en: Beyond output faithfulness, a growing body of work examines the reasoning traces themselves: whether they faithfully reflect the model’s underlying computation and whether they are internally sound. Turpin et al. (2023) showed that chain-of-thought (CoT) explanations can systematically misrepresent the true reason for a model’s prediction, for example when the answer is influenced by biasing features of the prompt that the explanation never mentions. Lanham et al. (2023) introduced perturbation-based methods to measure this faithfulness gap in CoT reasoning. More recently, attention has shifted to large reasoning models (LRMs), which produce extended thinking traces before generating a final answer. Marjanovic et al. (2026) conducted an in-depth analysis of DeepSeek-R1 reasoning chains and documented recurring behaviours, including speculative branching, self-contradiction, and repeated reversal of decisions, which closely resemble sub-types in our Reasoning Quality dimension. Lee and Hockenmaier (2025) surveyed methods for evaluating step-by-step reasoning traces and organised the evaluation criteria into groundedness, validity, coherence, and utility. Sun et al. (2025) investigated hallucination in LRMs from a mechanistic perspective, showing that hallucinations arising in reasoning traces can have causes distinct from those observed in conventional LLM outputs. Their findings highlight the importance of examining hallucinations at the reasoning-process level rather than treating them solely as properties of the final output.

paragraphs.en: The specific task of translating natural-language descriptions into UML diagrams has received growing attention. Cámara et al. (2023) reported on their experience of using ChatGPT for UML class-diagram generation and found strong performance on OCL constraints but critical limitations in scalability (beyond 10–12 classes), poor support for association classes, and high variability across prompts. Ferrari et al. (2024) examined sequence-diagram generation from 28 real-world requirements documents, reporting reasonable conformance to UML standards but significant degradation in completeness and correctness when requirements are ambiguous. Bari et al. (2024) evaluated LLMs on 20 class-diagram modelling exercises and found that, while outputs were generally understandable, issues of completeness and correctness remained, particularly for complex exercises. Conrardy and Cabot (2024) explored image-based UML generation and observed that even vision-enabled LLMs introduce structural errors when interpreting diagram images.
paragraphs.zh: 将自然语言描述转换为UML图这一具体任务受到了越来越多的关注。Cámara等人 （2023）报告了他们使用ChatGPT生成UML类图的经验，发现其在OCL约束上表现出色，但在可扩展性（超过10–12个类时）方面存在严重局限，对关联类的支持较差，且不同提示词之间的结果差异很大。Ferrari等人 （2024）基于28份真实需求文档考察了顺序图的生成，报告指出其结果基本符合UML标准，但当需求模糊时，完整性和正确性会显著下降。Bari等人 （2024）在20个类图建模练习上评估了大语言模型，发现虽然输出总体上可以理解，但完整性和正确性问题依然存在，尤其是在复杂练习中。 Conrardy和Cabot（2024）探索了基于图像的UML生成，并观察到即使是具备视觉能力的大语言模型在解读图图像时也会引入结构性错误。

paragraphs.en: A common finding across these studies is that LLM-generated UML diagrams frequently contain unsupported, missing, or contradictory elements, which we treat as hallucinations in this study. However, these works report such errors as observed phenomena at the output level, without analysing their types or origins. As noted above, no prior work offers a systematic taxonomy that explains how these hallucinations arise during the multi-stage reasoning process that reasoning-capable LLMs follow when generating diagrams.
paragraphs.zh: 这些研究的一个共同发现是，大语言模型生成的 UML 图经常包含不受支持的、缺失的或相互矛盾的元素，本研究将其视为幻觉。 然而，这些工作仅将此类错误作为输出层面观察到的现象加以报告，并未分析其类型或来源。 如上所述，尚无先前的工作提供一个系统性的分类体系，来解释这些幻觉是如何在具备推理能力的大语言模型生成图时所遵循的多阶段推理过程中产生的。

paragraphs.en: Existing hallucination mitigation strategies can be broadly grouped into four families ( Huang et al., 2025 ) : (i) training-time interventions, such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and direct preference optimisation (DPO); (ii) inference-time augmentation, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ( Lewis et al., 2020 ; Shuster et al., 2021 ) ; (iii) post-hoc verification and self-correction, in which the model checks and revises its own output after generation ( Dhuliawala et al., 2024 ; Manakul et al., 2023 ) ; and (iv) prompt engineering, which reshapes the input to a fixed model without modifying its weights.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的幻觉缓解策略大致可以分为四类（Huang et al., 2025）：(i) 训练时干预，例如基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）和直接偏好优化（DPO）；(ii) 推理时增强，例如检索增强生成（RAG）（Lewis et al., 2020; Shuster et al., 2021）；(iii) 事后验证与自我纠错，即模型在生成后检查并修订自身的输出（Dhuliawala et al., 2024; Manakul et al., 2023）；以及 (iv) 提示工程，即在不修改固定模型权重的前提下重塑其输入。

paragraphs.en: Prompt engineering is arguably the most accessible approach for practitioners using hosted, black-box models, and recent work has explored structured prompting to reduce hallucinations in various domains. Zhang et al. (2025a) demonstrated that decomposing spatial reasoning tasks into structured sub-steps significantly reduced hallucinations in path planning. Freeman et al. (2026) compared five prompt engineering strategies for industrial LLM applications and found that structured procedures with explicit verification steps produced more consistent, grounded outputs. Shim et al. (2025) proposed Curative Prompt Refinement, which reformulates ill-formed prompts to reduce hallucinatory outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 对于使用托管式黑盒模型的从业者而言，提示工程可以说是最容易上手的方法，近期的工作探索了结构化提示以减少各领域的幻觉。Zhang 等人 （2025a）证明，将空间推理任务分解为结构化的子步骤能显著减少路径规划中的幻觉。Freeman 等人 （2026）比较了工业级大语言模型应用中的五种提示工程策略，发现带有显式验证步骤的结构化流程能产生更一致、更扎根于事实的输出。Shim 等人 （2025）提出了治疗性提示细化（Curative Prompt Refinement），通过重新表述格式不良的提示来减少幻觉性输出。

paragraphs.en: In the software modelling domain, however, mitigation efforts remain limited. Prior UML generation studies ( Bari et al., 2024 ; Cámara et al., 2023 ; Ferrari et al., 2024 ) have reported structural errors but have not systematically attempted to prevent them. Where prompting strategies have been explored for modelling tasks, they have relied on generic techniques such as few-shot or chain-of-thought prompting without domain-specific error awareness ( Chen et al., 2023 ) . This gap motivates the mitigation experiment addressing RQ4 (Section 5 ), which operationalises the hallucination taxonomy as generation-time constraints and post-hoc verification rules, and evaluates whether these taxonomy-derived interventions improve diagram quality.

paragraphs.en: This dataset consists of 20 modelling exercises drawn from open-source educational materials. Each exercise provides a natural-language description and a validated reference UML class diagram. The exercises were selected based on two criteria: (i) the description was in a collector-readable language (English or Italian), and (ii) an accepted reference solution existed. paragraphs.en: In a preliminary step, two authors jointly examined 20 reasoning traces, together with their corresponding prompts and final diagrams, through qualitative open coding. Whenever the model introduced unsupported details, contradicted its earlier statements, or produced invalid UML constructs, the phenomenon was noted. Initial category labels and operational definitions were developed, and overlapping labels were merged through discussion to establish a preliminary codebook. The remaining 40 traces were then independently annotated by one author and a master’s student using the codebook. Disagreements were resolved through discussion to reach consensus.
paragraphs.zh: 在预备步骤中，两位作者通过定性开放式编码共同检查了20条推理轨迹，以及对应的提示词和最终图表。 每当模型引入缺乏依据的细节、与先前的表述相矛盾，或生成无效的UML结构时，都会记录该现象。 研究建立了初始类别标签和操作性定义，并通过讨论合并重叠的标签，形成初步编码手册。 随后，由一位作者和一名硕士生使用该编码手册对其余40条轨迹进行独立标注。 分歧通过讨论解决以达成共识。

paragraphs.en: To enable scalable hallucination detection without reliance on human ground truth, the manually established taxonomy was operationalised through a dual-LLM evaluation system. The first model (LLM as Annotator) identified suspected hallucinations by applying the taxonomy categories to each reasoning trace and PlantUML output. The second model (LLM as Judge) independently reviewed these annotations, confirming or rejecting each one and producing a verified set of hallucination counts per category. To ensure diversity of judgment and reduce model-specific bias, the annotator and judge were instantiated on different platforms: Claude 3.7 Sonnet (via Anthropic API) as annotator and GPT-4o (through OpenAI API) as judge. This approach builds on recent evidence that LLMs can serve as reliable evaluators with human-like agreement for open-ended assessments Zheng et al. (2023) and high consistency in code and text evaluation pipelines Tong and Zhang (2024) ; Gu et al. (2024) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了在不依赖人工真实标注的情况下实现可扩展的幻觉检测，该手动建立的分类体系通过一个双大语言模型评估系统得以落地实施。 第一个模型（大语言模型作为标注者）通过将分类体系的类别应用于每条推理轨迹和 PlantUML 输出，识别疑似幻觉。 第二个模型（大语言模型作为评判者）独立审查这些标注，对每条标注进行确认或拒绝，并产出一组经核实的、按类别统计的幻觉数量。 为确保判断的多样性并减少模型特定偏差，标注者和评判者被部署在不同的平台上：Claude 3.7 Sonnet（通过 Anthropic API）作为标注者，GPT-4o（通过 OpenAI API）作为评判者。 这一方法建立在近期证据之上，即大语言模型可以充当可靠的评估者，在开放式评估中达到与人类一致的契合度（Zheng et al. (2023)），并且在代码与文本评估流程中具有高度一致性（Tong and Zhang (2024)；Gu et al. (2024)）。

paragraphs.en: Identifying hallucinations in the reasoning traces of UML class-diagram generation is inherently difficult. DeepSeek-R1 reasoning traces are long and discursive, averaging approximately 4,800 tokens per trace (range 506–9,632). Identifying a hallucination requires the annotator to simultaneously hold the original prompt, the evolving reasoning chain, and the final PlantUML output in mind, and to judge whether a deviation is a genuine unsupported inference or a legitimate elaboration.
paragraphs.zh: 识别UML类图生成推理痕迹中的幻觉本质上是困难的。 DeepSeek-R1 的推理痕迹冗长且发散，平均每条约4,800个token（范围506–9,632）。 识别幻觉要求标注者同时记住原始提示词、不断展开的推理链以及最终的 PlantUML 输出，并判断某个偏差是真正的无依据推断还是合理的展开阐述。

paragraphs.en: To address this difficulty, the taxonomy was developed through a two-stage coding procedure (Section 3.1 ). In the first stage, two authors jointly examined 20 reasoning traces through open coding to elicit an initial set of category labels and operational definitions; overlapping labels were merged, and a stable codebook was produced through discussion. During this stage, initial observations suggested the presence of circular reasoning patterns; however, this candidate sub-type was ultimately excluded from the codebook because the raters could not agree on its operational boundaries. In the second stage, the codebook was applied independently to the remaining 40 traces by the first author and a master’s student in computer science, and disagreements were resolved through discussion until consensus was reached. The complete set of reasoning traces, generated PlantUML code, and annotations is available in our replication package. 1 1 1 https://github.com/MojdehRahmanian/HallucinationTaxonomy
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这一困难，该分类体系通过两阶段编码流程（3.1 节）开发而成。 在第一阶段，两位作者共同对 20 条推理轨迹进行开放编码，以提炼出一组初始类别标签及其操作性定义；重叠的标签被合并，并通过讨论形成了一套稳定的编码手册。 在这一阶段，初步观察显示存在循环推理模式；然而，由于评分者无法就其操作边界达成一致，该候选子类型最终被排除在编码手册之外。 在第二阶段，第一作者与一名计算机科学专业硕士生将编码手册独立应用于其余 40 条推理轨迹，分歧通过讨论解决，直至达成共识。 完整的推理轨迹集合、生成的 PlantUML 代码以及标注信息可在我们的复现包中获取。1 1 1 https://github.com/MojdehRahmanian/HallucinationTaxonomy

paragraphs.en: The resulting taxonomy organises hallucinations along three dimensions, each mapped to a distinct transition in the requirements-to-reasoning-to-code process (Figure 1 ). The first dimension, Prompt Faithfulness , captures hallucinations at the prompt-to-reasoning transition and contains four sub-types: Unsupported Entity, Unsupported Relation, Over-specific Detail, and Missed Requirement. The second dimension, Code Faithfulness , captures hallucinations at the reasoning-to-code transition and contains four sub-types: Dropped Step, Fabricated Code, Contradiction, and Structural Mismatch. The third dimension, Reasoning Quality , captures hallucinations internal to the reasoning chain and contains three sub-types: Speculative Branch, Goal Drift, and Tool Misuse.
paragraphs.zh: 由此得到的分类法从三个维度对幻觉进行组织，每个维度对应从需求到推理再到代码过程中的一个特定转换阶段（图 1）。 第一个维度是提示忠实性（Prompt Faithfulness），捕捉提示到推理转换阶段的幻觉，包含四个子类型：无依据实体、无依据关系、过度具体细节和遗漏需求。 第二个维度是代码忠实性（Code Faithfulness），捕捉推理到代码转换阶段的幻觉，包含四个子类型：步骤缺失、代码捏造、自相矛盾和结构不匹配。 第三个维度是推理质量（Reasoning Quality），捕捉推理链内部的幻觉，包含三个子类型：投机分支、目标漂移和工具误用。

paragraphs.en: To assess pre-consensus inter-rater consistency on the 40 independently annotated traces, we calculated pairwise F 1 F_{1} Hripcsak and Rothschild (2005) based on the hallucination instances identified by the two annotators. An instance was considered matched when both annotators identified the same hallucination at the same location in the trace. Here, n n denotes the number of distinct instances identified by at least one annotator within each dimension, and N N denotes the total across all three dimensions. Pairwise F 1 F_{1} was 79.78% for Prompt Faithfulness ( n = 107 n=107 ), 94.04% for Code Faithfulness ( n = 160 n=160 ), and 61.90% for Reasoning Quality ( n = 116 n=116 ), with an overall micro-averaged F 1 F_{1} of 81.79% ( N = 383 N=383 ). The lower consistency for Reasoning Quality reflects the difficulty noted above: judging whether a reasoning step is unsound requires assessing the reasoning process itself rather than comparing it with the prompt or the generated code. The first 20 traces were coded jointly during codebook development and therefore have no independent pre-consensus annotations; all subsequent analyses (RQ2 and RQ3) use the consensus annotations of all 60 traces.

paragraphs.en: Section 4.2 defines each sub-type and illustrates it with a representative example from the coded traces.
paragraphs.zh: 4.2 节定义了每个子类型，并从编码的轨迹中选取一个代表性示例加以说明。

paragraphs.en: The following subsections define the sub-types of each dimension, specifying the unit of analysis and the decision rule applied during annotation, and illustrate each sub-type with a representative example from the coded traces.
paragraphs.zh: 以下小节定义了每个维度的子类型，明确了分析单元以及标注过程中应用的判定规则，并从已编码的轨迹中选取代表性示例对每个子类型加以说明。

paragraphs.en: This dimension captures cases where the model’s reasoning chain introduces or omits content relative to the input requirements, independent of the final PlantUML output. We apply an evidence rule: every committed element in the chain (entity, relation, attribute, multiplicity, operation) must be justified by an explicit span in the prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 该维度捕捉模型的推理链相对于输入要求引入或遗漏内容的情况，与最终的 PlantUML 输出无关。 我们应用一条证据规则：推理链中每个被提交的元素（实体、关系、属性、多重性、操作）都必须由提示词中的明确片段来支撑。

sents.zh: 该维度捕捉模型的推理链相对于输入要求引入或遗漏内容的情况，与最终的 PlantUML 输出无关。

paragraphs.en: We label an Unsupported Entity when the chain introduces a class or interface that has no explicit textual basis in the exercise description. The unit of analysis is a single classifier (class/interface).
paragraphs.zh: 当思维链引入在练习描述中没有明确文本依据的类或接口时，我们将其标注为不支持实体（Unsupported Entity）。 分析单元是单个分类器（类/接口）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 illustrates this pattern. The model introduces the Supplier and RestockOrder classes, even though the prompt does not mention these concepts. The prompt only describes operations related to customers, subscriptions, and movie ordering, not supply-chain interactions. These additional entities are therefore considered unsupported, illustrating how the model fabricates new classes that extend beyond the given requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 展示了这种模式。 该模型引入了 Supplier 和 RestockOrder 类，尽管提示词中并未提及这些概念。 提示词只描述了与客户、订阅和电影订购相关的操作，并未涉及供应链交互。 因此，这些额外的实体被视为不受支持的，说明该模型会编造超出给定需求的新类。

paragraphs.en: We mark an Unsupported Relation when the reasoning trace asserts an association, generalisation, aggregation/composition, or a specific direction/multiplicity between entities without a justifying span in the requirement description. The unit of analysis is a single relation. Implicit co-occurrence (“orders include items”) does not license composition, containment, or arrow direction unless the text states it; similarly, inheritance requires an explicit subtype cue.
paragraphs.zh: 当推理轨迹断言了实体之间存在关联、泛化、聚合/组合或特定的方向/多重性，而需求描述中没有可作依据的文段时，我们将其标记为「不支持的关系」。 分析单位是单个关系。 隐含的共现（如“订单包含条目”）不能作为组合、包含或箭头方向的依据，除非文本明确陈述；同样，继承关系需要明确的子类型提示。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 illustrates this. The model infers and commits to two associations (Project–Requirement and Project–System) with multiplicities and directionality, even though the requirement description only mentions that a project uses requirements and produces a system. The text does not specify ownership, creation, or multiplicity relations, yet the model interprets these as composition and assigns cardinalities. These added structural commitments are not supported by the requirement description and therefore constitute Unsupported Relations.
paragraphs.zh: 图 3 说明了这一点。 尽管需求描述只提到一个项目使用需求并产出一个系统，模型却推断并确定了两个关联（Project–Requirement 与 Project–System），并赋予了多重性和方向性。 文本并未指明所有权、创建或多重性关系，但模型将其解释为组合关系并分配了基数。 这些额外添加的结构性确定并未得到需求描述的支持，因此构成了“无支持关系”（Unsupported Relations）。

paragraphs.en: We count Over-specific Detail when the reasoning trace invents multiplicities, datatypes, attributes, or operation signatures that go beyond what the requirement description specifies. The unit of analysis is a property, multiplicity, or signature. Numeric or cardinality cues in the text (e.g., “exactly one”) justify commitments; otherwise, defaults like 1..* , concrete types such as DateTime , or extra parameters are considered invented. Neutral placeholders (e.g., {type TBD} ) are acceptable and not penalised.
paragraphs.zh: 当推理轨迹中虚构出超出需求描述所规定范围的多重性、数据类型、属性或操作签名时，我们将其计为过度具体细节（Over-specific Detail）。 分析的单位是一个属性、多重性或签名。 文本中的数值或基数提示（例如「恰好一个」）可以证明相关设定的合理性；否则，像 1..* 这样的默认值、诸如 DateTime 的具体类型，或额外的参数都被视为虚构。 中性占位符（例如 {type TBD}）是可以接受的，不会被判罚。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 illustrates this. The model introduces additional details that are not supported by the requirement description, including specific attributes ( dateOfBirth , gender ), datatypes ( String , Date ), and an operation ( scheduleAppointment ) with parameters. The requirement description only mentions the presence of a patient record system but provides no attribute-level or procedural details. These added elements therefore represent Over-specific Details, meaning plausible yet fabricated information that extends beyond the given requirements.

paragraphs.en: We tag Speculative Branch when the reasoning trace introduces hedged alternatives (“maybe/possibly/if needed”) that add entities, relations, or assumptions without citing evidence from the requirement description. These alternatives are typically abandoned or never resolved. If a speculative branch is explicitly retracted with a rationale and leaves no unsupported commitment, it is recorded but considered lower severity. However, if the speculation propagates into later design decisions or forces reversals downstream, it is scored as a significant fault.
paragraphs.zh: 当推理过程引入了模棱两可的替代方案（“也许/可能/如有需要”），在不引用需求描述证据的情况下添加实体、关系或假设时，我们将其标记为「推测分支」。 这些替代方案通常会被放弃或从未得到解决。 如果推测分支被明确撤回并附有理由，且未留下任何无依据的承诺，则会被记录但视为较低严重度。 然而，如果该推测传播到后续的设计决策中，或迫使下游做出逆转，则会被评为重大缺陷。

paragraphs.en: Figure 9 illustrates this. The reasoning trace introduces a possible Factory entity and a one-to-many relation with Machine , even though the requirement description provides no explicit evidence for either. The model repeatedly speculates about whether to include or omit the Factory class, changing its decision several times before discarding it. paragraphs.en: We label Tool Misuse when the reasoning trace proposes PlantUML or UML constructs with incorrect semantics or syntax, such as composition without lifecycle dependency, using inheritance to model a role, misusing realisation/interfaces, or invalid multiplicities. paragraphs.en: Applying the dual-LLM evaluation pipeline (Section 3.2 ) to the 120 descriptions in Dataset 2 yielded the distribution shown in Figure 13 . paragraphs.en: To assess the consistency of the dual-LLM annotation pipeline with human judgement, one author independently annotated a stratified random sample of 30 reasoning traces (25% of Dataset 2). We compared hallucination instances identified by the pipeline and the human annotator using pairwise F1, considering an instance matched when both identified the same hallucination at the same location in the trace. Pairwise F1 was 77.93% for Prompt Faithfulness ( n = 130 n=130 ), 87.60% for Code Faithfulness ( n = 145 n=145 ), and 81.60% for Reasoning Quality ( n = 74 n=74 ), with an overall micro-averaged F1 of 82.89% ( N = 349 N=349 ). Here, n n denotes the number of distinct hallucination instances identified by at least one of the two annotation methods within each dimension, while N N denotes the total across all three dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估双大语言模型标注流程与人类判断的一致性，一位作者独立标注了一个分层随机抽样的30条推理轨迹样本（占数据集2的25%）。 我们使用成对F1比较了该流程与人类标注者识别出的幻觉实例，当两者在轨迹中同一位置识别出同一幻觉时，即认为该实例匹配。 提示忠实度（n=130）的成对F1为77.93%，代码忠实度（n=145）的成对F1为87.60%，推理质量（n=74）的成对F1为81.60%，总体微平均F1为82.89%（N=349）。 其中，n表示在各个维度内由两种标注方法中至少一种识别出的不同幻觉实例的数量，而N表示三个维度的总数。

paragraphs.en: To assess whether the proposed taxonomy generalises beyond the model used for its initial construction, we repeated the procedure on all 20 descriptions from Dataset 1 using the more recent DeepSeek-V4-Pro model at temperature 1. The resulting 20 reasoning traces were annotated manually following the procedure in Section 3.1 . The taxonomy remained applicable to the new traces, but the distribution of hallucination dimensions differed substantially from that observed for DeepSeek-R1 on the same descriptions (Table 3 and Figure 14 ). Prompt Faithfulness became the most frequent dimension (56.7%), followed by Reasoning Quality (37.5%), while Code Faithfulness decreased sharply to 5.8%. All six Code Faithfulness instances were classified as Contradiction (B3), corresponding specifically to multiplicity reversals between the reasoning trace and the generated code. Within Prompt Faithfulness, Unsupported Relation (A2; 20.2% of all hallucinations) and Over-specific Detail (A3; 19.2%) were the two most frequent sub-types. Over-specific Detail thus remained among the leading Prompt Faithfulness sub-types, as in Datasets 1 and 2, whereas Unsupported Relation, which accounted for only 5.5% of hallucinations in Dataset 1, became considerably more prominent.

paragraphs.en: Using Dataset 1, we examined the association between reasoning-trace length (in tokens) and the number of hallucination errors per run. Figure 15 presents the mean total errors across four quartiles of reasoning length ( n = 15 n=15 runs per quartile). Descriptively, the binned means suggest an inverted-U pattern, with fewer errors in the shortest (Q1: 6.20) and longest (Q4: 5.93) quartiles and higher error counts in the middle quartiles (Q2: 7.27; Q3: 8.67). Thus, the inverted-U pattern should be interpreted as a descriptive tendency rather than evidence of a statistically established relationship.

paragraphs.en: We examined the association between requirement complexity, computed using Equation ( 1 ), and hallucination frequency. Requirement complexity showed a negative correlation with overall hallucination frequency (Spearman ρ = − 0.325 \rho=-0.325 , p = 0.011 p=0.011 ), indicating that runs with higher requirement-complexity scores tended to exhibit fewer annotated hallucinations. This association was most pronounced for Prompt Faithfulness ( ρ = − 0.375 \rho=-0.375 , p = 0.003 p=0.003 ), while correlations with Reasoning Quality ( ρ = − 0.209 \rho=-0.209 , p = 0.110 p=0.110 ) and Code Faithfulness ( ρ = − 0.173 \rho=-0.173 , p = 0.187 p=0.187 ) were not statistically significant. paragraphs.en: To answer RQ4, we evaluated whether embedding the taxonomy as generation-time constraints and post-hoc verification rules can improve diagram quality.
paragraphs.zh: 为了回答 RQ4，我们评估了将分类法嵌入为生成时约束和事后验证规则是否能够提升图表质量。

paragraphs.en: Three conditions were designed to isolate the effects of embedding different taxonomy dimensions into the generation pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设计了三种条件，以隔离将不同分类维度嵌入生成流程中所产生的影响。

paragraphs.en: Condition 1, Baseline: A plain system prompt with no taxonomy awareness and no post-hoc verification. The model receives a minimal instruction (“You are a helpful assistant that creates UML class diagrams”) and generates PlantUML code from the requirement description. This serves as the control.
paragraphs.zh: 条件 1，基线：一个普通的系统提示词，不包含分类体系感知，也没有事后验证。 模型接收一条最简指令（“你是一个创建 UML 类图的有用助手”），并根据需求描述生成 PlantUML 代码。 该条件作为对照组。

sents.zh: 条件 1，基线：一个普通的系统提示词，不包含分类体系感知，也没有事后验证。

sents.en: The model receives a minimal instruction (“You are a helpful assistant that creates UML class diagrams”) and generates PlantUML code from the requirement description.
sents.zh: 模型接收一条最简指令（“你是一个创建 UML 类图的有用助手”），并根据需求描述生成 PlantUML 代码。

paragraphs.en: Condition 2, Taxonomy-Aware Generation: The system prompt encodes two taxonomy dimensions as explicit generation constraints: Prompt Faithfulness (A1–A4) and Reasoning Quality (C1–C3). The model is instructed to identify every entity, action, and constraint in the requirement; justify each class with an explicit quotation from the text; assign multiplicities only when textually supported; and re-read the requirement to verify completeness before finalising. Key constraints prohibit introducing unsupported entities or relations (A1, A2), inventing datatypes or multiplicities (A3), using composition without lifecycle dependency (C3), and speculative branching (C1).
paragraphs.zh: 条件2，分类法感知生成：系统提示词将两个分类法维度编码为显式的生成约束：提示忠实度（A1–A4）与推理质量（C1–C3）。 模型被指示识别需求中的每一个实体、动作和约束；用文本中的明确引文为每个类提供依据；仅在文本支持时才指定多重性；并在定稿前重读需求以验证完整性。 关键约束禁止引入无依据的实体或关系（A1、A2），杜撰数据类型或多重性（A3），在没有生命周期依赖的情况下使用组合（C3），以及进行投机性分支（C1）。

paragraphs.en: Generated diagrams were evaluated against the gold-standard PlantUML solutions from Dataset 3 along the two semantic-quality dimensions of completeness and correctness introduced by Lindland et al. (1994) in their framework for conceptual-modelling quality. We adapt these dimensions to the UML class-diagram setting by decomposing each into three structural categories, classes, attributes, and relationships and scoring every category on a 0–100% scale. This yields six per-diagram metrics: three completeness (recall) measures (i.e., Class Completeness, Attribute Completeness, and Relationship Completeness) and three correctness (precision) measures (i.e., Class Correctness, Attribute Correctness, and Relationship Correctness). The gold solution served as the primary reference; the natural-language description was used as a secondary reference to validate whether deviations were semantically justified. Evaluation scores were independently reviewed and verified by two authors.

paragraphs.en: First, Code Faithfulness was the most frequently observed failure dimension for DeepSeek-R1, highlighting discrepancies between reasoning and generated diagram code. However, the distribution of hallucination dimensions differed for DeepSeek-V4-Pro, suggesting that the relative prevalence of failure types may depend on the model. Second, the relationships between hallucination frequency and the examined characteristics were mixed. Reasoning-trace length showed no significant monotonic association with hallucination frequency, whereas requirement complexity was negatively associated with overall hallucination frequency and Prompt Faithfulness errors in Dataset 1. Third, incorporating taxonomy-derived guidance into generation prompts improved mean overall F1 across all three evaluated models, although the statistical evidence varied across model-condition comparisons. Notably, these improvements were obtained through guidance targeting Prompt Faithfulness and Reasoning Quality, despite Code Faithfulness being the most frequent failure dimension for DeepSeek-R1. This suggests that the most frequently observed failure dimension is not necessarily the only useful target for intervention.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，代码忠实度是 DeepSeek-R1 中最常被观察到的失败维度，凸显了推理过程与所生成图表代码之间的不一致。 然而，DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的幻觉维度分布有所不同，这表明失败类型的相对普遍程度可能取决于具体模型。 其次，幻觉频率与所考察特征之间的关系并不一致。 推理轨迹长度与幻觉频率之间没有显著的单调关联，而在数据集 1 中，需求复杂度与总体幻觉频率以及提示词忠实度错误呈负相关。 第三，将基于分类学-derived 的指导信息纳入生成提示词后，三个受评估模型的平均总体 F1 值均有所提升，尽管不同模型-条件对比之间的统计证据存在差异。 值得注意的是，这些改进是通过针对提示词忠实度和推理质量的指导实现的，尽管代码忠实度是 DeepSeek-R1 中最常出现的失败维度。 这表明最常被观察到的失败维度并不一定是干预的唯一有效目标。

paragraphs.en: The cross-model analysis qualifies the pattern above. For DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Code Faithfulness accounted for only 5.8% of observed hallucinations, all involving multiplicity reversals between the reasoning trace and the generated code, while Prompt Faithfulness (56.7%) and Reasoning Quality (37.5%) became the dominant dimensions. The taxonomy remained applicable to the new traces, suggesting that it captures failure modes that recur across models, although their relative prevalence may differ substantially. In particular, the reasoning-to-code transition, which was the dominant failure site for DeepSeek-R1, showed substantially fewer observed failures for DeepSeek-V4-Pro, although hallucinations were not eliminated overall. The persistence of Over-specific Detail as the leading Prompt Faithfulness sub-type across the analysed datasets and models suggests that some individual failure patterns may be more stable than their aggregate frequencies. Because the cross-model analysis is based on only 20 traces at a single temperature, these findings provide preliminary evidence of transferability and should be confirmed through a more systematic cross-model evaluation.

paragraphs.en: Two characteristics of UML relationships may help explain this difficulty. First, natural-l anguage requirements may leave relationship properties implicit or underspecified. For example, a statement such as “students enrol in courses” identifies related entities but does not necessarily specify multiplicity, navigability, or whether enrolment should be modelled as a direct association or an association class. Second, identifying appropriate relationships may require integrating information distributed across multiple requirements rather than relying on local textual matches. Although these explanations were not directly tested, they suggest potential directions for future interventions, including few-shot examples of common relationship patterns, explicit relationship inventories, and dedicated multiplicity verification.

paragraphs.en: One qualitative observation from the manual coding of Dataset 1 is worth noting alongside the quantitative findings: a recurring prompt-echoing pattern in which the model restates a span of the requirement verbatim within its reasoning trace before committing to a structural decision. Echoing was typically signalled by phrases such as “the problem says…”, “the description states that…”, or “it says…”. In our coded traces it appeared to function as a boundary marker between grounded reasoning and speculative commitment: the model frequently used the echo as an apparent justification for a structural decision that the prompt did not in fact support, treating the recitation itself as evidence. Figure 16 shows a representative case from the project-modelling exercise, in which the model echoes “work products are created, used, updated, and elaborated throughout the project” and then commits to composition between Project and its Requirements/System. The resulting commitment was coded as Unsupported Relation (A2): the prompt’s verb “produces” licenses a general association but not the lifecycle dependency that composition implies. Operationally, echo-then-commit transitions are mechanically simple to detect—a sliding-window match between the reasoning trace and the prompt—and could be incorporated into existing LLM observability pipelines to flag candidate hallucinations for review.
paragraphs.zh: 对数据集1进行人工编码时观察到的一个质性现象值得与量化结果一并指出：模型反复出现一种“复述提示词”的模式，即在做出结构性决策之前，先在推理轨迹中原样复述需求中的某一段文字。 这种复述行为通常由诸如“题目说……”、“描述中写道……”或“它说……”之类的短语标记出来。 在我们编码的推理轨迹中，它似乎起到了在有据推理与投机性决策之间的边界标记作用：模型经常把这种复述当作某项结构性决策的表面依据，而提示词实际上并不支持该决策，即把复述本身当作了证据。 图16展示了项目建模练习中的一个代表性案例：模型复述了“工作产品在整个项目过程中被创建、使用、更新和细化”，随后在Project与其Requirements/System之间做出了组合关系的决策。 由此产生的决策被编码为“无支持关系”（A2）：提示词中的动词“produces（产生）”只能支持一般性的关联，而无法支持组合关系所隐含的生命周期依赖。 从操作层面看，“先复述后决策”的转换在机械上很容易检测——只需在推理轨迹与提示词之间做滑动窗口匹配——因此可以被纳入现有的LLM可观测性流水线中，用于标记候选幻觉以供审查。

paragraphs.en: Two practical implications follow from our findings for practitioners using reasoning-capable LLMs to generate UML class diagrams. First, incorporating modelling-specific constraints into the generation prompt can be useful: across all three evaluated models, the Taxonomy-Aware prompt improved diagram quality relative to the minimal Baseline prompt. Second, relationship modelling warrants particular attention during generation and review. Relationship F 1 F_{1} was the lowest structural metric across all models and conditions, including after Taxonomy-Aware Generation. Practitioners may therefore benefit from explicitly checking generated relationships and multiplicities against the source requirements rather than relying only on the overall plausibility of the diagram. More broadly, our findings suggest that improving LLM-based UML generation may benefit from modelling-specific mechanisms for grounding and validating structural decisions alongside general reasoning capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 对于使用具备推理能力的大语言模型生成 UML 类图的从业者而言，我们的发现带来了两点实践启示。 首先，在生成提示词中纳入建模相关的特定约束可能是有用的：在所有三个被评估的模型中，分类感知提示词相对于最简基线提示词都提升了图的质量。 其次，关系建模在生成与评审过程中值得特别关注。 在所有模型和条件下，包括采用分类感知生成之后，关系 F1 F_{1} 都是最低的结构性指标。 因此，从业者可能受益于依据源需求显式检查生成的关系和多重性，而不是仅仅依赖图的整体合理性。 更广泛地说，我们的发现表明，改进基于大语言模型的 UML 生成，除了通用推理能力之外，可能还需要用于落实和验证结构化决策的建模相关特定机制。

paragraphs.en: Internal Validity. The taxonomy was developed through manual coding and subsequent independent annotation, with disagreements resolved through discussion and consensus. Researcher interpretation may nevertheless have influenced category boundaries and the classification of borderline cases. Although pre-consensus consistency was assessed using pairwise F1, the lower agreement observed for Reasoning Quality indicates greater annotation uncertainty within this dimension. A further limitation concerns the interpretation of reasoning traces. Our analysis treats the emitted reasoning text as observable evidence of the model’s reasoning process. However, these traces may not faithfully or completely represent the model’s underlying computation. Consequently, the identified hallucination patterns should be understood as discrepancies observable in the generated traces rather than definitive evidence of the model’s internal decision-making mechanisms.

paragraphs.en: Conclusion Validity. The mitigation experiment (RQ4) involved only 13 paired cases per model, limiting the statistical power of the Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. Although several improvements were statistically significant, some did not remain significant after Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons. Non-significant results should therefore not be interpreted as evidence of no effect. The correlation analyses (RQ3) were restricted to 60 reasoning traces from Dataset 1, limiting sensitivity to small associations. paragraphs.en: This paper investigated hallucinations in UML class-diagram generation by reasoning-capable LLMs, moving beyond the observation of structural errors to characterise how and where they arise during generation. From manually coded reasoning traces and large-scale automated validation, we developed a taxonomy comprising three dimensions: Prompt Faithfulness, Code Faithfulness, and Reasoning Quality. These dimensions correspond to distinct stages of the requirements-to-reasoning-to-code process.
paragraphs.zh: 本文研究了具备推理能力的大语言模型在 UML 类图生成中的幻觉问题，不再停留于对结构性错误的观察，而是刻画这些错误在生成过程中如何产生以及产生于何处。 通过对推理轨迹的人工编码以及大规模自动化验证，我们构建了一个包含三个维度的分类体系：提示忠实度、代码忠实度和推理质量。 这些维度对应于从需求到推理再到代码这一过程中的不同阶段。

sents.zh: 这些维度对应于从需求到推理再到代码这一过程中的不同阶段。

paragraphs.en: Our results show that Code Faithfulness is the most frequent failure dimension in both DeepSeek-R1 datasets, but that the distribution of hallucinations varies across models. Reasoning-trace length showed no significant association with hallucination frequency, while requirement complexity was negatively associated with overall hallucination frequency and Prompt Faithfulness errors. Most importantly, the taxonomy is actionable: incorporating its Prompt Faithfulness and Reasoning Quality dimensions into the generation prompt increased pooled mean Overall F 1 F_{1} by 4.0 pp across the evaluated models, while an additional post-hoc Code Faithfulness review provided no consistent benefit. This suggests that understanding the origins of hallucinations can inform interventions aimed at preventing errors during generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果表明，代码忠实度是两个 DeepSeek-R1 数据集中最常见的失败维度，但幻觉的分布在各模型之间有所不同。 推理轨迹的长度与幻觉频率没有显著关联，而需求复杂度与整体幻觉频率以及提示忠实度错误呈负相关。 最重要的是，该分类法是可操作的：将其中提示忠实度和推理质量维度纳入生成提示后，在被评估的模型上使合并平均 Overall F 1 F_{1} 提升了 4.0 个百分点，而额外的后验代码忠实度审查则没有带来一致的收益。 这表明，理解幻觉的成因可以为旨在防止生成过程中出现错误的干预措施提供指导。

paragraphs.en: Relationship modelling remains a persistent challenge, consistently yielding the lowest scores across models and conditions. Future work will therefore focus on relationship-specific mitigation, broader UML diagram types, larger industrial datasets, and human validation of reasoning-level categories. We will also investigate prompt echoing as a potential runtime signal for detecting unsupported structural commitments.
paragraphs.zh: 关系建模仍然是一个持续的挑战，在所有模型和条件下始终得到最低的分数。 因此，未来的工作将专注于针对关系的缓解措施、更广泛的UML图类型、更大规模的工业数据集，以及对推理层面类别的人工验证。 我们还将研究提示词回显作为一种潜在的运行时信号，用于检测不受支持的结构性承诺。

paragraphs.en: More broadly, this work demonstrates the value of studying LLM hallucinations not only as defects in generated artefacts, but as failures that emerge along a generation process. For software modelling, such a process-oriented view offers a foundation for developing more reliable and controllable LLM-based engineering tools.
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛地说，这项工作表明，研究大语言模型的幻觉不仅应被视为生成产物中的缺陷，更应被视为在生成过程中涌现的失败，这体现了此类研究的价值。 对于软件建模而言，这种面向过程的视角为开发更可靠、更可控的基于大语言模型的工程工具奠定了基础。
